title: Director, HR Business Partner for HR
description: <p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at <a href="http://www.take2games.com/">http://www.take2games.com</a>.</p> <p>We are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.</p> <p><strong>The Challenge</strong></p> <p>The HR function at Take-Two is one of the most complex and high stakes client groups in the organization, spanning three labels (Take-Two, 2K, and Zynga), thousands of employees globally, and a leadership team navigating constant transformation. As the <strong>Director, HR Business Partner for HR</strong>, you won't just support the business, you are the business.</p> <p>In this role, you'll serve as the strategic partner to HR leadership teams across all three labels, helping translate enterprise HR strategy into actionable people programs, org design decisions, and operating plans. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, bringing the same rigor and partnership to the HR function that HRBPs bring to their client groups in the business every day. It's a rare opportunity to shape how a world-class people organization runs, from the inside.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Take On</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary strategic partner to the HR leadership teams across Zynga, 2K, and Take-Two, translating HR strategy into priorities, programs, and operating plans for the global HR function.</li> <li>Lead workforce planning and organizational design for HR teams, including role clarity, resourcing decisions, and structural recommendations, ensuring the function is built to support current and future business needs.</li> <li>Drive talent management for HR leaders and critical HR roles, including succession planning, leadership development, performance calibration, and targeted retention strategies.</li> <li>Advise on compensation, mobility, and promotions within the HR function in partnership with Total Rewards, ensuring internal equity and market competitiveness.</li> <li>Lead and sponsor change initiatives that impact the HR function, owning scope, timeline, stakeholder engagement, and change readiness from start to finish.</li> <li>Manage HR risk and employee relations escalations that arise within the HR function, coordinating with Legal and Employee Relations to resolve matters with discretion and confidentiality.</li> <li>Deliver people analytics and actionable insights that inform decision-making HR leaders, turning data into clear recommendations.</li> <li>Co-design and deliver HR programs in partnership with Centers of Expertise (Total Rewards, Talent, Learning, People Ops), sharing accountability for program quality and adoption across the function.</li> <li>Ensure compliance across HR policies and programs in partnership with Legal and Compliance, accounting for multi-jurisdictional employment law and data privacy requirements.</li> <li>Partner with Finance and the SVP of HR to align HR headcount, operating spend, and investments to budget, with shared accountability for financial outcomes.</li> <li>Coordinate cross-functional HR initiatives with Business HRBPs and People Ops, ensuring consistent execution, clear handoffs, and alignment across the broader organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience, including direct support of senior leadership (VP level and above) in a complex, matrixed organization.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience supporting an HR function as a client group, with an understanding of the unique dynamics of partnering with people professionals.</li> <li>Strong organizational design and workforce planning capabilities, with the ability to translate business strategy into structural and staffing recommendations.</li> <li>Track record leading talent management programs, including succession planning, leadership development, and performance calibration for senior and critical roles.</li> <li>Experience managing HR risk and employee relations escalations with sound judgment, discretion, and collaboration with Legal.</li> <li>Proficiency with people analytics, with the ability to synthesize data into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Change management expertise, including planning, stakeholder engagement, and adoption measurement for large-scale initiatives.</li> <li>Exceptional stakeholder influence skills, with comfort pushing back, building consensus, and navigating competing priorities across multiple leadership teams.</li> <li>Working knowledge of multi-jurisdictional employment law, particularly across North America (US and Canada required; additional geographies a plus).</li> <li>Commercial acumen and budget awareness, with experience partnering with Finance on headcount planning and operating spend.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Great to Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in the gaming, entertainment, or tech industry.</li> <li>Exposure to a multi-label or multi-brand corporate structure.</li> <li>Familiarity with HR tools and platforms used in enterprise-scale people operations (e.g., Workday).</li> <li>Coaching certification or formal leadership development training.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer You</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Great Company Culture</strong>. Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.</li> <li><strong>Growth</strong>: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.</li> <li><strong>Work Hard, Play Hard.</strong> Our employees bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through company parties, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.</li> <li><strong>Benefits</strong>. Medical (HSA & FSA), dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan, commuter benefits, in-house wellness program, broad learning & development opportunities, a charitable giving platform with company match and more!</li> <li><strong>Perks</strong>. Fitness allowance, employee discount programs, free games & events, stocked pantries and more!</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><em>Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (“T2”) is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization.  Employment at T2 is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.</em></p> <p><em>Please be aware that Take-Two does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scam or phishing exercise. Take-Two’s in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a take2games.com email domain). If you need to report an issue or otherwise have questions, please contact ----- <p><em>The pay range for this position in Toronto at the start of employment is expected to be between $126,000 and $176,000 CAD per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.</em></p> <p><em>Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. </em><strong><em>Ontario only:</em></strong><em> The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy. </em></p> <p> </p> <p><em>#LI-Hybrid</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-path-to-node="17"> </p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Software Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong>Role Overview:</strong></p> <p>The Director of Finance Systems Engineering is a technology and engineering leader responsible for delivering and evolving systems that enable critical Finance capabilities. Reporting to a Senior Director in IT, this role will lead teams responsible for enterprise planning and forecasting platforms, custom-built Finance solutions, and SaaS applications that complement the core SAP ERP ecosystem.</p> <p>The Director will lead a multidisciplinary team that includes planning model builders, systems analysts/product owners/TPMs, and software engineering professionals. This leader will partner closely with Finance to translate business priorities and transformation objectives into scalable technology solutions that simplify processes, improve decision making, and enable greater use of data, automation, AI, and machine learning.</p> <p>A key responsibility of the role is strengthening the team’s ability to connect Finance domain expertise with specialized data and machine learning capabilities, enabling Finance to translate its AI and ML objectives into scalable solutions.</p> <p>The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and people leadership with Finance domain knowledge and experience across enterprise planning platforms, custom software development, SaaS solutions, integration architectures, data, and AI/ML technologies.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>Finance Systems Leadership & Business Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for planning and forecasting platforms, custom Finance solutions, and Finance-related SaaS applications.</li> <li>Partner with Finance leaders to understand business priorities and translate Finance transformation objectives into technology strategies, roadmaps, and solutions.</li> <li>Own the technology portfolio and multi-year roadmap balancing business priorities, technical debt, platform lifecycle, and operational sustainability.</li> <li>Establish engineering and product practices that balance speed, business value, user experience, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.</li> <li>Develop strong partnerships with Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, ML Engineering, Integration, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and other technology teams to deliver cohesive end-to-end solutions.</li> <li>Manage strategic technology vendors and implementation partners to ensure successful delivery, operational excellence, and continuous innovation.</li> <li>Build and develop a high performing organization across model building, systems analysis/product ownership, and software engineering disciplines while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Planning, Finance Applications & Software Engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide technology leadership for enterprise-scale financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario-modeling solutions used across Finance.</li> <li>Lead the engineering, maintenance, and support of custom applications and services that address Finance-specific business requirements.</li> <li>Provide leadership for Finance SaaS applications adjacent to the core SAP ERP ecosystem.</li> <li>Ensure Finance solutions integrate effectively with SAP and the broader enterprise application and data ecosystem while maintaining appropriate architectural standards and controls.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI, ML and Data Enablement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Finance leaders to identify opportunities where data, AI, and machine learning can improve planning, forecasting, financial analysis, automation, and decision making.</li> <li>Assess capability gaps and establish development plans, role expectations, and ways of working that prepare the Finance Systems Engineering organization to collaborate effectively with Data Engineering and ML Engineering teams.</li> <li>Enable teams to translate Finance business problems and domain knowledge into well-defined data, AI, and ML use cases.</li> <li>Partner with specialized technology teams to incorporate enterprise data, predictive models, and AI/ML services into Finance applications and business processes.</li> <li>Define how Finance Systems Engineering will evaluate, adopt, and govern AI and ML capabilities available through enterprise applications, internal data and ML platforms, and approved external services.</li> <li>Help drive adoption and operationalization of AI/ML capabilities within Finance while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data governance, security, privacy, and technology standards</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.</li> <li>10+ years of progressive experience leading enterprise application or software engineering organizations in a large enterprise environment, including accountability for multidisciplinary teams, technology delivery, and operational performance.</li> <li>5+ years leading through managers, including responsibility for organizational design, talent development, performance management, and succession planning.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience building and leading multidisciplinary teams across software engineering, enterprise applications, planning applications, systems analysis, product ownership, and technical program management</li> <li>Experience leading enterprise scale financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario-modeling platforms, including responsibility for platform strategy, delivery, lifecycle management, and operational performance.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Finance processes, particularly financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and related Finance operations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to partner with senior business leaders, translate business and transformation objectives into technology strategy and execution, and own multi-year portfolio roadmaps that balance business priorities, technical debt, platform lifecycle, and operational sustainability.</li> <li>Strong understanding of software engineering, enterprise architecture, integration, data, and cloud concepts.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to develop technical talent and build new capabilities within an engineering organization, including preparing teams to partner effectively with Data Engineering and ML Engineering and to operationalize data, AI, and machine learning capabilities.</li> <li>Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross functional leadership skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with one or more enterprise-scale planning and forecasting platforms, such as Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning, or SAP Analytics Cloud, including solution design, model governance, integration, or platform administration.</li> <li>Experience leading software engineering teams building custom enterprise solutions using Golang, Java or comparable programming languages.</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and streaming architectures and enterprise integration patterns.</li> <li>Experience leading a portfolio of Finance SaaS solutions, such as Coupa, Rightsline, or comparable platforms, including vendor management, integration, lifecycle planning, and operational governance.</li> <li>Experience with SAP S/4HANA and integration of Finance applications and services with the core ERP environment.</li> <li>Experience in jointly delivering production AI or machine learning capabilities with Data Engineering and ML Engineering teams, including integration into enterprise applications or business processes.</li> <li>Understanding of how AI and machine learning can be applied responsibly to Finance use cases, including forecasting, predictive insights, anomaly detection, decision support, and process automation, with attention to data governance, security, privacy, and enterprise technology standards.</li> <li>Experience supporting technology enabled Finance transformation within a large, global organization.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.</p> <p class="p1">Please refer to our <a href="https://www.playstation.com/legal/careers-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p><em>Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.</em></p> <p><em>We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond. </em></p> <p><em>Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate Fire Engineer 2027 Start - Glasgow
description: <p><strong>Graduate Fire Engineer 2027 Start – Glasgow</strong></p> <p><strong>Glasgow, Scotland</strong></p> <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we’ve been helping make our world safe, secure and resilient since 1939. Today, our global network of experts works across fire protection engineering, security and risk-based fields, including<br>accessibility consulting, risk analysis, process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management and digital innovation.</p> <p>Our engineers and consultants work together to solve complex safety and security challenges, helping our clients protect what matters most. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we continue toadvance the science of safety and make a meaningful difference to the communities we serve.</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives, skills and talents they bring to our organisation.</p> <p>Our Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organisation, supporting career development and creating opportunities to share experiences, build connections and learn from one another.</p> <p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>Ready to start a career where your engineering skills can make a real difference?</p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Fire Engineer to join Jensen Hughes across the UK and Ireland and become part of our 2,000+ global employees working together to advance the science of safety every day.</p> <p>These roles are open across our UK & Ireland offices. Please apply only to your preferred location. If you are open to more than one location, we will discuss this with you during the recruitment process.</p> <p><strong><em>Please note: to be considered for this role, you must have the right to work in the UK or Ireland.</em></strong></p> <p><strong>Why join Jensen Hughes and grow your career?</strong></p> <p><strong>Your career can go further than you think.</strong> 74% of our current Directors and Technical Directors in the UK & Ireland started their careers with us as graduates.</p> <p><strong>Be part of a leading fire consultancy.</strong> We have offices across Belgium, Finland, Italy, Denmark and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.</p> <p><strong>Learn from experienced engineers.</strong> As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic design team. Working alongside experienced Engineers, you will receive ongoing technical support to build your knowledge and experience across fire engineering projects.</p> <p><strong>Build your career in a supportive environment.</strong> You’ll have the opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team where we strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.</p> <p><strong>Take responsibility early.</strong> You will be given early responsibility and the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to work towards chartered status through the Institute of Fire Engineers, providing help and support throughout the process.</p> <p><strong>What will you be working on?</strong></p> <p>As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you’ll work on a variety of exciting projects, helping to develop innovative fire engineering solutions for new and existing buildings.</p> <p>Your work will include:</p> <ul> <li>Carrying out fire engineering analysis on a<br>range of new and existing building projects.</li> <li>Working across a diverse range of buildings,<br>including high-rise office buildings, large retail complexes and airport<br>developments, each presenting its own unique challenges.</li> <li>Analysing fire growth, means of escape,<br>structural fire resistance and smoke control using a variety of methods,<br>including computer modelling software such as Computational Fluid Dynamics.</li> <li>Preparing technical reports and liaising with<br>clients, including some of the largest building developers in the country.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <p>To set you up for success in the role, you’ll need:</p> <ul> <li>Right to work in the UK or Ireland.</li> <li>A Master’s degree, achieved within the last two<br>years or expected, in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering,<br>Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Physics.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication<br>skills in English.</li> <li>Additional qualifications and experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>The following would also help you succeed in the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A team player who can work effectively with<br>colleagues at all levels.</li> <li>Excellent communication and time management<br>skills.</li> <li>Enthusiasm to innovate.</li> <li>A second European language is an advantage but<br>not essential.</li> </ul> <p>We’ve successfully welcomed Graduate Fire Engineers from a variety of STEM Master’s backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering and Physics. Many of these individuals have gone on to build outstanding careers with us.</p> <p>If you’re committed to pursuing a career in Fire Engineering and have a transferable STEM Master’s degree, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us why you’re ready to start your career with Jensen Hughes.</p> <p><strong>Graduate Development Programme</strong></p> <p>Starting your career is about more than your first role, it’s about building the foundations for your future.</p> <p>Our Graduate Development Programme gives you hands-on project experience, mentorship and support as you work towards professional accreditation. Over two years, you’ll gain experience across fire engineering and related disciplines, helping you build the knowledge and skills needed for a successful and impactful career.</p> <p>You’ll also have the opportunity to undertake <strong>Continuing Professional Development (CPD)</strong> as you progress through the programme, helping you continue to develop your technical knowledge and professional skills. We provide support and encouragement for Engineers working towards <strong>Chartered Engineer status</strong>, helping you work towards this important professional milestone as you build your career with Jensen Hughes.</p> <p><strong>Sustainability in Fire Engineering</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, fire safety and sustainability go hand in hand.</p> <p>In the UK, we support the design of safe, energy-efficient and sustainable buildings that meet BREEAM standards and align with net-zero goals. As a graduate, you’ll play a role in delivering solutions that protect people while helping to create a more sustainable built environment.</p> <p><strong>Our People Are Our Greatest Asset</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation of our success. To attract and retain the best talent, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance, and professional growth.</p> <p><strong>Our UK&I Benefits Include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Private medical insurance</li> <li>33 days of holiday(including<br>bank holidays) with an additional day after 3 years</li> <li>Industry-leading contributory pension scheme</li> <li>4x life assurance</li> <li>Income protection scheme</li> <li>Discretionary bonus scheme</li> <li>Employee assistance programme</li> <li>Enhanced parental-related pay</li> <li>Recognition and reward programmers to celebrate<br>team efforts</li> <li>Access to extensive technical training and<br>resources</li> </ul> <p><strong>Supporting Your Work-Life Balance:</strong></p> <p>We understand the importance of flexibility and balance. We're happy to discuss hybrid, part-time, and flexible working arrangements to suit both you and the business. For certain teams, this may include an early Friday finish at 3 pm once contracted hours and client deadlines are met. We also offer:</p> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours and patterns</li> <li>Flexible holiday use over Christmas/New Year</li> <li>Enhanced holiday entitlement after three years</li> <li>The option to carry over up to five unused<br>holiday days into the next year (subject to discussion and approval)</li> </ul> <p><strong>A Commitment to Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <p>Our benefits represent a meaningful investment in both our people and the future of Jensen Hughes. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.</strong></em></p> <p> </p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.  We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.  Please click <strong><a href="https://www.jensenhughes.com/careers/responsible-use-of-ai-in-the-jensen-hughes-recruitment-process">here</a></strong> to review.</p> <p><br>The security of your personal data is important to us. Wavemaker, EssenceMediacom, Mindshare and T&P are our agency teams, these house multiple local and global clients.  In addition, we have several dedicated client brands, such as OpenDoor (Amazon), MFG (Google), OpenMind (Nestle), OpenConnect (BT/EE) and Media Futures Group (Google).  All of these teams are supported by consistent capabilities, enterprise level tools and systems and our market leading OPEN platform.</p> <p><strong>About WPP Media Group Operations:</strong>  WPP Media Group Operations is a central function within WPP, dedicated to driving operational excellence and efficiency across the business. rollout.</p> <p><strong>Skills & Attributes</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with a passion for innovation and a proven ability to manage ambiguous, forward-looking projects determine business impact, ROI, and scalability.</li> <li>Market Curiosity: A genuine passion for staying ahead of industry trends, with a deep interest in emerging technologies like AI and their practical application in a business context.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Project & Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ambiguity Navigation: The ability to manage innovation projects from start to finish, creating structure, clear plans, and milestones where none existed before.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Collaboration: A talent for building coalitions and working with diverse teams (e.g., Technology, Finance, People) to get pilot projects off the ground and secure their expert contribution.</li> <li>Influential Communication: The ability to articulate the goals, progress, and outcomes of innovation projects to a wide range of stakeholders, including senior leadership, building excitement and buy-in along the way.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Candidate Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>8-10+ years of experience in a role focused on innovation, business transformation, strategy, or internal consulting.</li> <li>Proven experience taking conceptual ideas and turning them into tangible projects, pilot programs, or new business capabilities.</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with experience managing complex, ambiguous projects in an innovation or R&D context.</li> <li>Excellent business analysis and financial modeling skills, with experience building business cases and measuring the impact of new initiatives.</li> <li>Familiarity with emerging technologies like AI/automation and a deep understanding of how they can be applied to drive business value.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Measures of Success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Within 6 Months: You will have taken ownership of one or two key innovation initiatives from the Advancement roadmap. You will have designed and launched a structured pilot program for your primary initiative, complete with clear goals, metrics, a project plan, and strong engagement from supporting teams.</li> <li>Within 12 Months: You will have completed your first major pilot program, delivering a comprehensive analysis of the results to senior leadership. This will include a clear recommendation on the initiative's potential for wider rollout and a refined business case based on real-world data. You will be recognized as a key leader in driving the innovation agenda, successfully translating vision into proven concepts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WPP Media Values:</strong> </p> <p>WPP media is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate the fact that everyone is unique and that's what makes us so good at what we do. We pride ourselves on being a company that embraces difference and truly represents the global clients we work with.</p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><div class="m_8972703100365155930Ltr m_8972703100365155930OutlineElement m_8972703100365155930SCX45225805"> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers: </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role. The Role We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader. In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed. The Team You Will Lead You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in: On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments. Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. Cloud environments: GCP and AWS Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD) The Operational Reality It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources. Context Switching is the Norm You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve. Agility over Silos Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum. Focus Management Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time. As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will: People Leadership & Talent Development Team Management Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management. Formal Training & Growth Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports. Recruitment & Retention Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture. Culture of Learning Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference. Strategic & Operational Management Budget & Capacity Planning Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware. Risk & Contingency Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity. Procedure & Frameworks Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards. Prioritisation Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations. Technical Support & Oversight Performance Optimisation Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them. Visual Documentation Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor. Hybrid Estate Management Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments. Unblocking Issues Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover. General Duties On-Call Duties Willingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-Hoc Carry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations. Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Leadership & Management Competencies Proven Management Experience Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc). Project Management Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment. Communication Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members. Goal Oriented You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met. ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts. Technical Environment & Team Capabilities Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions. For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration. Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey. Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation. Innovation & Debt Management A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt. Advanced Containerization Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems. Observability Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana). Data Streaming Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid. Web & Storage Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster. Tooling Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation. Version Control strong understanding of Git and version control best practices. Why This Role? If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business UK Benefits & Perks 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year Private Medical Insurance through Vitality Enhanced pension contributions Cycle to Work scheme Eye Care Vouchers Life Assurance Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program Regular company events and activities Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. title: Head of Financial Planning & Analysis
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring for the <strong>Head of Financial Planning & Analysis</strong>, to lead the global FP&A Teams and be a leader within the wider finance team. You will play a key part leading our monthly business reviews and forecasting, annual planning, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment, as well as develop the long term roadmap for the FP&A team. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a proven record of leading a team to use data analysis to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.</p> <p>Our business opportunity is significant; we can deliver both infrastructure and business applications to the enterprise market. As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote role in AMER or EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Develop executive reporting dashboards and documents including Board reporting, monthly financial results and other management presentations</li> <li>Analyse & Report monthly results, leading indicators and KPIs to support monthly forecasting and annual plan attainment</li> <li>Provide commercial analysis, develop growth targets, and evaluate strategic initiatives</li> <li>Work with product managers to produce, aggregate, and distribute both market insights and competitive intelligence</li> <li>Manage financial models, including budgeting, forecasting, and long range planning</li> <li>Drive improvements in data analysis, and determine the appropriate processes, methodologies, and modeling techniques to deliver insights.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting and Investor Relations to support month end close, flux review processes, and financial reporting</li> <li>Drive multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Play a key role in preparation of critical public financial documents to support an IPO process, including supporting the production of investor materials and public filings</li> <li>Guide the annual FP&A activity calendar to provide decision support to the executive team</li> <li>Mentor colleagues within the FP&A team, as well as peer teams</li> <li>Control costs via methodical reviews of department spend, procurement strategies, and business wide process efficiency</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record</li> <li>Experience and a deeply rooted passion to lead successful team members, and aid in their career growth </li> <li>Have operated in a high growth, multi currency/geography technology business with a mixed go-to-market motion</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities</li> <li>Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character</li> <li>Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects</li> <li>Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial modeling, and BI tools</li> <li>Understanding of core accounting principles </li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passionate, thoughtful, and self-motivated</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments </li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent combination of professional certifications and experience</li> <li>Previous experience as a subject matter expert in Financial Planning & Analysis</li> <li>Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. description: <p><strong>The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick start your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team. </p> <p>Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/P ledgers, process supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, prepare supplier payments, deal with queries effectively and efficiently and maintain compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.</p> <p>In return we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development including offering you with support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.</p> <h3><strong>A day in the life of an Accounts Payable Clerk</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy of our A/P ledgers and reconciliation of accounts</li> <li>Manage our vendor data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of vendor data changes and approvals</li> <li>Process our supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner</li> <li>Prepare our supplier payments in line with the payments timetable and presented for approval in a clear and organised format</li> <li>Identify payments properly withheld, monitored and released when approval given</li> <li>Help with our month end processes: prepayments, accruals, bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations</li> <li>Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner</li> <li>Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you will bring to the role</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject</li> <li>Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, look ups etc.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail, with great organisation skills and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers</li> <li>A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career</li> <li>Experience using an exterprise level accounting system </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li>Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS2</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. It’s how our customers move, receive, spend and manage their money, from cards and bank transfers to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, payment experiences in the app, and the platform infrastructure that underpins the whole bank.</p> <p>This role sits in our Payments Platform area, working most closely with our Finance Infrastructure squad. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited by complex, technical infrastructure. The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <ul> <li>Defining the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.</li> <li>Moving the team from reactive delivery towards a more strategic, product-led approach, asking why we’re From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role. This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person.
